sql:
SELECT
              c.company_name
            FROM
              dim_company AS c
            JOIN
              fct_posting AS p
            ON
              c.company_key = p.company_key
            WHERE
              p.remote_us = TRUE
            GROUP BY
              c.company_name
            ORDER BY
              COUNT(p.posting_key) DESC
            LIMIT 1
